sa_s27_i.desc: lower-case information 'i' (130 wide, 235 high) (traced from the sheet's filled artwork)

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet S27 (information bay, formerly S124): 420 x 350; 'i' 40 from the left, BAY 80 D (202 wide, 38 from the right). Layout: 420 x 350, blue, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): symbol lower-case information 'i' (130 wide, 235 high) x 41-170 y 56-290; BAY 80 D white top 145 x 180-382 (202).
